<HistoricalDocument xmlns="http://example.com/historicaldocument">
  <Metadata>
    <Language>Latin</Language>
    <WritingDirection>ltr</WritingDirection>
    <PhysicalDescription>Printed book page, two columns.</PhysicalDescription>
    <Description>Biblical text from Genesis, chapters III and V.</Description>
    <Script>Latin</Script>
  </Metadata>
  <Page>
    <Header>
      <Heading type="running_title">
        <Line>CAP. IIII.</Line>
      </Heading>
      <Heading type="main">
        <Line>GENESIS.</Line>
      </Heading>
      <Heading type="running_title">
        <Line>CAP. V.</Line>
      </Heading>
      <PageNumber>3</PageNumber>
    </Header>
    <Body>
      <MarginalNote placement="left_margin">
        <Line>Adam.</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>7 Nónne ſi bene egeris, recipies: ſin autem</Line>
        <Line>malè, ſtatim in foribus peccatum-tuum'</Line>
        <Line>aderit? ſed ſub te erit appetitus eius, & tu</Line>
        <Line>dominaberis illius.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <MarginalNote placement="left_margin">
        <Line>-12.</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line><Initial type="simple">B</Initial> 8 Dixitq́; Cain ad Abel fratrem ſuum: Egre-</Line>
        <Line>diamur foras. Cumq́; eſſent in agro, con-</Line>
        <Line>ſurrexit Cain aduerſus fratrem ſuum Abel,</Line>
        <Line>& interfecit eum.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <MarginalNote placement="left_margin">
        <Line>Sap. 10.</Line>
        <Line>4.3.</Line>
        <Line>Matt.23.</Line>
        <Line>e.35.</Line>
        <Line>1.Iohan.</Line>
        <Line>3.b.12.</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>9 Et ait Dominus ad Cain, Vbi eſt Abel fra-</Line>
        <Line>ter tuus? Qui reſpondit, Neſcio: Nunquid</Line>
        <Line>cuſtos fratris mei ſum ego?</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>10 Dixitq́; ad eum: Quid feciſti? vox ſangui-</Line>
        <Line>nis fratris tui clamat ad me de terra.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <MarginalNote placement="left_margin">
        <Line>Ind.1.d.11.</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>11 Nunc igitur maledictus eris ſuper terram:</Line>
        <Line>quæ aperuit os ſuũ, & ſuſcepit ſanguinem</Line>
        <Line>fratris tui de manu tua.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>12 Cùm operatus fueris eam, non dabit tibi</Line>
        <Line>fructus ſuos: vagus & profugus eris ſuper</Line>
        <Line>terram.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>13 Dixitq́; Cain ad Dominum: Maior eſt ini-</Line>
        <Line>quitas mea, quàm ut veniam merear.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>14 Ecce eijcis me hodie à facie terræ, & à fa-</Line>
        <Line>cie tua abſcondar, & ero vagus & profugus</Line>
        <Line>in terra: omnis igitur qui inuenerit me, oc-</Line>
        <Line>cidet me. Dixitq́; ei Dominus:</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <MarginalNote placement="left_margin">
        <Line>C</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>15 Nequaquam ita fiet: ſed omnis qui occi-</Line>
        <Line>derit Cain, ſeptuplum punietur. Poſuitq́ue</Line>
        <Line>Dominus in Cain ſignum, vt non interfi-</Line>
        <Line>ceret eum omnis qui inueniſſet eum.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>16 Egreſſusq́; Cain à facie Domini, habita-</Line>
        <Line>uit profugus in terra ad orientalem pla-</Line>
        <Line>gam Eden.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>17 Cognouit autem Cain vxorem ſuam, quæ</Line>
        <Line>concepit, & peperit Henoch: & ædificauit</Line>
        <Line>ciuitatem, vocauitq́; nomen eius ex nomi-</Line>
        <Line>ne filij ſui, Henoch.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>18 Porrò Henoch genuit Irad, & Irad genuit</Line>
        <Line>Maüiael, & Maüiael genuit Mathuſael, &</Line>
        <Line>Mathuſael genuit Lamech.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>19 Qui accepit duas vxores, nomen vni Ada,</Line>
        <Line>& nomen alteri Sella.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>20 Genuitq́; Ada Iabel, qui fuit pater habi-</Line>
        <Line>tantium in tentorijs, atq; paſtorum:</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <MarginalNote placement="left_margin">
        <Line>D</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>21 Et nomen fratris eius Iubal, ipſe fuit pater</Line>
        <Line>canentium cithara & organo.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>22 Sella quoq; genuit Tubal-cain, qui fuit</Line>
        <Line>malleator & faber in cuncta opera æris &</Line>
        <Line>ferri. Soror verò Tubal-cain, Noëma.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>23 Dixitq́; Lamech vxoribus ſuis Adæ & Sel-</Line>
        <Line>læ: Audite vocem meam vxores Lamech,</Line>
        <Line>auſcultate ſermonem meum: quoniam oc-</Line>
        <Line>cidi virum in vulnus meum, & adoleſcen-</Line>
        <Line>tulum in liuorem meum.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>24 Septuplum vltio dabitur de Cain; de La-</Line>
        <Line>mech verò ſeptuagies ſepties.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>25 Cognouit quoque adhuc Adam vxorem</Line>
        <Line>ſuam, & peperit filium, vocauitq́; nomen</Line>
        <Line>eius Seth: dicens, Poſuit mihi Deus ſemen</Line>
        <Line>aliud pro Abel, quem occidit Cain.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>26 Sed & Seth natus eſt filius, quem vocauit</Line>
        <Line>Enos, iſte cœpit inuocare nomen Domini.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Heading type="sub">
        <Line>CAPVT V.</Line>
      </Heading>
      <Heading type="sub">
        <Line>Propagatio Adæ ac poſteriorum, anniq́; vitæ ipſo-</Line>
        <Line>rum uſq́; ad Noë.</Line>
      </Heading>
      <MarginalNote placement="right_margin">
        <Line>A</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line><Initial type="drop">H</Initial>Ic eſt liber generationis Adam. In die</Line>
        <Line>qua creauit Deus hominem, ad ſimilitu-</Line>
        <Line>dinem Dei fecit illum.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <MarginalNote placement="right_margin">
        <Line>Sap. 2. d. 24.</Line>
        <Line>Eccl.17.a.1.</Line>
        <Line>Sup. 1.d. 28.</Line>
        <Line>Inf. 9.a.6.</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>2 Maſculum & fœminam creauit eos: & be-</Line>
        <Line>nedixit illis: & vocauit nomen eorum A-</Line>
        <Line>dam, in die quo creati ſunt.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>3 Vixit autẽ Adam centum triginta annis:</Line>
        <Line>& genuit-filium' ad imaginẽ & ſimilitudi-</Line>
        <Line>nem ſuam, vocauitq́; nomen eius Seth.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <MarginalNote placement="right_margin">
        <Line>-6.</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>4 Et facti ſunt dies Adam poſtquam genuit</Line>
        <Line>Seth, octingenti anni: genuitq́ue filios &</Line>
        <Line>filias.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <MarginalNote placement="right_margin">
        <Line>1.Par.1.A.1.</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>5 Et factum eſt omne tempus quod vixit A-</Line>
        <Line>dam, anni nongenti triginta, & mortuus</Line>
        <Line>eſt.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>6 Vixit quoq; Seth centum quinq; annis, &</Line>
        <Line>genuit Enos:</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <MarginalNote placement="right_margin">
        <Line>B</Line>
      </MarginalNote>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>7 Vixitq́; Seth poſtquam genuit Enos, octin</Line>
        <Line>gentis ſeptem annis, genuitq́ue filios & fi-</Line>
        <Line>lias.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>8 Et facti ſunt omnes dies Seth nongento-</Line>
        <Line>rum duodecim annorum, & mortuus eſt.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>9 Vixit verò Enos nonaginta annis, & ge-</Line>
        <Line>nuit Cainan.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>10 Poſt cuius ortum vixit octingentis quin-</Line>
        <Line>decim annis, & genuit filios & filias.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>11 Factiq́; ſunt omnes dies Enos nongenti</Line>
        <Line>quinq; anni, & mortuus eſt.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>12 Vixit quoq; Cainan ſeptuaginta annis, &</Line>
        <Line>genuit Malaleel.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>13 Et vixit Cainan poſtquam genuit Mala-</Line>
        <Line>leel, octingentis quadraginta annis, genuit-</Line>
        <Line>q́ue filios & filias.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>14 Et facti ſunt omnes dies Cainan nogen-</Line>
        <Line>ti decem anni, & mortuus eſt.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>15 Vixit autem Malaleel ſexaginta quinque</Line>
        <Line>annis, & genuit Iared.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>16 Et vixit Malaleel poſtquam genuit Iared,</Line>
        <Line>octingentis triginta annis: & genuit filios</Line>
        <Line>& filias.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>17 Et facti ſunt omnes dies Malaleel octin-</Line>
        <Line>genti nonaginta quinq; anni, & mortuus</Line>
        <Line>eſt.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>
        <Line>18 Vixitq́ue Iared centum ſexaginta duobus</Line>
        <Line>annis, & genuit Henoch.</Line>
      </Paragraph>
    </Body>
    <Footer>
      <SignatureMark>A 3</SignatureMark>
      <CatchWord>Et</CatchWord>
    </Footer>
  </Page>
